# CareerTrack Lite

> CareerTrack is a free, private job application tracker with a kanban pipeline, interview calendar, and real-time analytics. Built for job seekers who want surgical precision in their search: organize applications, store job descriptions and resume links, track statuses from Saved to Offer, and measure response rates, interview conversion, and time-to-interview.

## Core features
- Kanban pipeline with 6 stages: Saved, Applied, Assessment, Interview, Rejected, Offer (drag-and-drop)
- Applications hub with list, kanban board, and saved-jobs views
- Full-text search across job titles, companies, and stored job descriptions
- Interview scheduling with a calendar view
- Analytics: response rate, interview rate, offer rate, monthly velocity, average time to interview, source breakdown
- Resume management: store per-application resume versions and job-description links
- AI career copilot: match scoring and skill gap analysis per application
- Private, secure: JWT auth (httpOnly cookie) + bcrypt password hashing, per-user data isolation

## Key pages
- Home: https://careertrack.app/
- Sign in: https://careertrack.app/login
- Create account: https://careertrack.app/register

## Documentation
The application is a full-stack product (React 18 + Vite frontend, Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL backend). API endpoints under /api require authentication.

## Support
For issues or feedback, contact the maintainer (Shahnawas Adeel). The product is free to use with no credit card required.
